## Checklist

- [ ] I have signed this project's **Contributor License Agreement** (opened a
      PR adding my signature file, with the full CLA text, to the
      [CLA-Ledger](https://github.com/CloudSecurityAlliance/CLA-Ledger));
      the CLA check on this PR will confirm it.
- [ ] My contribution is my own work (or I have the right to submit it) per
      the CLA.
- [ ] Any co-authors of the **text** have each signed the CLA (group discussion
      or ideas alone don't require signing); any `Co-authored-by:` trailers name
      only signed co-authors.
- [ ] If this changes the **schema or data model**, I have updated
      `DESIGN-RATIONALE-STIX-EXTENSIONS.md` (or noted why not).
- [ ] I have not pasted substantive catalog content into an issue — it's here
      as a PR so the CLA covers it.
- [ ] External standards/regulations are **referenced by ID, not reproduced** —
      no copyrighted standard text (e.g. ISO/IEC) is pasted in.
- [ ] I have listed the **sources** behind any mapping or claim, and any
      third-party material is identified as such.
